description.zh: 设置了仅主动出规则的IPv6地址的ID。
description.en: The ID of the IPv6 address for which the IPv6 egress-only rule is configured.

description.zh:
需要设置仅主动出规则的实例类型，取值：

- IPv6Address（默认值）：代表当前实例是单个 IPv6 IP。
- IPv6Prefix：代表当前实例是 IPv6 Cidr。
description.en:
The type of the instance for which you want to configure IPv6 egress-only rules. Valid values:

- IPv6Address (default): The instance is a single IPv6 address.
- IPv6Prefix: The instance is an IPv6 CIDR block.

description.zh: 要查看的仅主动出规则ID。
description.en: The ID of the IPv6 egress-only rule to query.
The ID of the IPv6 gateway.
The page number of the list to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为**50**，默认值为**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh: IPv6网关的地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
